description: This file defines data models and methods related to channel bookmarks in the Mattermost application, including types, validation, cloning, and conversion functions.

classes.name: ChannelBookmarkType
classes.description: String type representing the type of channel bookmark (link or file).

classes.name: ChannelBookmark
classes.description: Data model for a channel bookmark, including validation and utility methods.

classes.name: ChannelBookmarkPatch
classes.description: Structure for partial updates to a ChannelBookmark.

classes.name: ChannelBookmarkWithFileInfo
classes.description: ChannelBookmark extended with associated file information.

classes.name: ChannelWithBookmarks
classes.description: Channel data combined with its bookmarks.

classes.name: ChannelWithTeamDataAndBookmarks
classes.description: Channel data with team info and bookmarks.

classes.name: UpdateChannelBookmarkResponse
classes.description: Response structure for updating or deleting a channel bookmark.

classes.name: ChannelBookmarkAndFileInfo
classes.description: Aggregated data combining channel bookmark info with file metadata.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the bookmark's audit information.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the ChannelBookmark or ChannelBookmarkWithFileInfo.

methods.name: SetOriginal
methods.description: Creates a new bookmark based on the current one, resetting timestamps and IDs.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the ChannelBookmark for saving, generating IDs and sanitizing fields.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates timestamps and sanitizes fields before updating.

methods.name: ToBookmarkWithFileInfo
methods.description: Converts a ChannelBookmark to a ChannelBookmarkWithFileInfo, optionally attaching file info.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to a ChannelBookmark.
